items.summary: On the Register page, when the user clicks the 'Proceed to Payment' button, save the displayed total amount (numeric value, stripped of the ₹ symbol) to localStorage under the key 'vibecxAmount', then navigate to the Payment page. Use the existing totalAmount display element as the source value.

On the Payment page, on load, read the 'vibecxAmount' value from localStorage and display it as '₹<amount>' in the QR amount display element. Also populate a hidden input field with the raw numeric amount. No fee recalculation must occur on the Payment page — only the stored value must be used.
